verdict.rationale: Airbyte's sync-mode docs show that syncs are configured per stream/table (full refresh vs incremental) and that a connection can be re-run to backfill history without touching other streams, matching the story's intent [airbyte-docs-7][airbyte-docs-23][airbyte-docs-22]. However, a hands-on account shows resyncing a very large (8B-row) single table required a manual workaround ('tricked Airbyte') rather than a clean built-in resync flow, indicating real-world limits [airbyte-comm-4]. Missing for 10: explicit docs on a UI/API 'reset/resync single stream' action, and independent confirmation that large-table resyncs work smoothly without workarounds.
